atoms.statement: Existing Character Formation sample is the base UI; new mockups must delta-edit rather than recreate.
Travel-preparation/packing is a context layer, not a replacement UI language.
No completed user character appears before A/B/C candidate generation.
All six companions appear throughout formation to build familiarity.
One companion is selected as primary partner; the other five remain active crew and are not rejected.
Companion canonical_name is immutable identity; display_name may change and nickname history is preserved.
Nickname history, first meeting, shared adventures and notable events feed the encyclopedia/history experience.
Dubi, Tori, Ink, Nova, Take and Zero use their approved Visual IDs unchanged.
User mood/expression direction may affect only the user character, never companion Visual IDs.
Companions may vary expression, pose, gesture, action, position and dialogue while preserving locked Visual IDs.
Companion self-promotion should be witty, lively and character-specific rather than identical or overly animated.
Signature Item remains exactly-one minimal packing choice, not a broad customization editor.
Avoid sterile white-only backgrounds; use a warm pre-departure basecamp with layered travel-prep props and depth.
Motion is subordinate to clarity; use subtle state/attention motion only and support reduced motion.
User character and companion crew keep different anatomy but share rendering, materials, apparel grammar, equipment family, emblem language, lighting and environment palette.
Shared scene hierarchy is USER=PROTAGONIST, SELECTED_COMPANION=PARTNER, OTHER_5=CREW/WORLD_CHARACTERS.
Two supplied child photos are source-reference inputs for likeness/style application, not canonical generated Visual IDs until approved.
Recent generated mockups are reference-only and not canonical because some recreated layout or drifted companion Visual IDs.
Final Character Formation UI mockup is not locked; exact approved base sample and locked companion assets must be recovered before the next mockup.
